speaker: rep
text: Hi, this is Andreas from Duab in Sweden — we supply scanners and printers for cold-storage warehouses. Did I catch you at an okay time?

speaker: customer
text: You did, actually. We just took over a frozen-goods terminal in Aarhus and the equipment situation is a mess.

speaker: rep
text: What scanning equipment came with the terminal?

speaker: customer
text: A mixed bag of old handhelds. Half of them die within an hour inside the freezer.

speaker: customer
text: Do you have anything properly rated for minus thirty?

speaker: rep
text: We do — the X60 is freezer-rated, IP67, and runs about fourteen hours in cold environments.

speaker: customer
text: Sounds promising. Send me the spec sheet and a ballpark price for twenty units.

speaker: rep
text: Will do — spec sheet and indicative pricing for twenty X60 units today.
